2. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioners and learned counsel for respondent No.2 jointly submit that the dispute between the parties has been amicably settled and the parties have today filed an application under Section 359 read with Section 528 of BNSS, 2023, reporting settlement and praying to allow the petition.
4. The said application is taken on record.
The application is supported by the affidavit of petitioner No.1/husband and the affidavit of respondent No.2/wife.

In paragraph Nos.2 to 4 of the affidavit filed on behalf of respondent No.2/wife, it is stated as follows:-
"2) That, I am the complainant in C.C.No.920/2024 (Crime.No.06/2024) and same is registered by Sindhanur Town P.S. for offences NC: 2025:KHC-K:712 punishable U/s 498A, 323, 114, 504, 506 R/w 34 of IPC.
That, I have filed the complaint against the petitioners.

That due to intervention of family members, elderly persons & well wishers of our respective families, myself and petitioners settled the dispute on following terms:
(a) The petitioner No.1 agreed to file petition seeking divorce on mutual consent U/s 13B of the Hindu Marriage Act before the Senior Civil Judge Sindhanur within 10-02- 2025.
On filing the said petition, the respondent No.2 appear and give consent for passing the decree of divorce on or before 28-02-2025.

(b) That, I am agreed to withdraw the M.C.No.40/2024, filed U/s 13(i) (i-a) of Hindu Marriage Act for Dissolution of Marriage, pending on the file of learned Senior Civil Judge Sindhanur on or before 10-02-2025.

(c) That, the petitioners are also agreed to withdraw the W.P.No.203890/2024 filed before this Hon'ble Court seeking quashing entire proceedings in I.A.No.1 on M.C.No.40/2024 before the learned Senior Civil Judge at Sindhanur.

(e) That, the petitioners are also agreed to withdraw of Crl.P.No.200838/2024 filed before this Hon'ble Court seeking quashing entire proceedings in Crl.Misc.No.672/2024.
